heading.en: Origins and move to the Polish Navy

body.zh-Hant: IPN 的人物文章寫道，約瑟夫·翁魯格於1884年10月7日出生，出生地為柏林附近的勃蘭登堡。他在德意志帝國海軍服役，擔任過小艦隊指揮官。1919年5月19日，他表示願意在波蘭海軍服役。
body.en: The IPN biographical article says Józef Unrug was born on 7 October 1884 in Brandenburg near Berlin. He served in the navy of the German Empire as a flotilla commander. On 19 May 1919 he declared his readiness to serve in the Polish navy.

body.zh-Hant: IPN 文章的標題稱他為1925至1939年的波蘭海軍司令。文中寫到，他於1925年成為第二波蘭共和國的艦隊司令，並於1933年晉升為少將（kontradmirał）。1939年大戰前夕，他接任艦隊暨海岸防禦司令。
body.en: The IPN article's title calls him commander of the Polish Navy in 1925–1939. The text says he became commander of the fleet of the Second Republic in 1925 and was promoted to rear admiral (kontradmirał) in 1933. Just before the Second World War broke out, he took the post of commander of the Fleet and Coastal Defence.

body.zh-Hant: 美國陸軍戰史寫到，1939年10月1日，Hela 的指揮官翁魯格少將要求談判投降。IPN 文章則稱投降於1939年10月2日11時生效，Hel 成為波蘭軍隊最後投降的要塞。IPN 九月專題另提到，在海岸地帶，翁魯格與斯坦尼斯瓦夫·當布克上校的部隊曾擊退來犯的攻擊。
body.en: The US Army study says that on 1 October 1939 Rear Admiral J. Unrug, commander at Hela, requested a surrender parley. The IPN article gives 2 October 1939 at 11:00 for the capitulation and calls Hel the last fortress of the Polish Army to surrender. The IPN September portal adds that on the coast the forces of Unrug and Col. Stanisław Dąbek repulsed attacks.

body.zh-Hant: IPN 文章寫道，翁魯格被關進德軍戰俘營，並拒絕德方提供的 Kriegsmarine 職位；1945年4月29日，美軍解放了他所在的 Murnau 戰俘營。戰後在英國，他於1946年9月2日晉升為中將（wiceadmirał）。文章並稱他於1973年在法國去世。
body.en: The IPN article says Unrug was held in a German officers' prisoner-of-war camp and rejected posts offered by the Germans in the Kriegsmarine; American soldiers liberated the Murnau camp on 29 April 1945. After the war, in Britain, he was promoted to vice admiral (wiceadmirał) on 2 September 1946. The article says he died in France in 1973.
